svg.title: Literature review and historical source criticism
svg.desc: 1. Form a focused question. Identify relevant databases, archives, concepts and eligibility.. 2. Retrieve and record sources. Search dates, strategies, citations, accession numbers and access limits.. 3. Distinguish source and study identity. Deduplicate records and link multiple publications from the same study.. 4. Critically examine the evidence. For historical material check provenance, purpose, context and corroboration.. 5. Synthesize and annotate. Compare findings, limitations and relevance. Mark unresolved uncertainty.

g.text: Literature review and historical source criticism
Separate a source's identity, content and contribution.
Identify relevant databases, archives, concepts and eligibility.
Search dates, strategies, citations, accession numbers and access limits.
Deduplicate records and link multiple publications from the same study.
For historical material check provenance, purpose, context and corroboration.
Compare findings, limitations and relevance. Mark unresolved uncertainty.
Authentic historical documents can still contain inaccurate or biased statements.
